title: AI Changes the Unit of Software Work
summary: Defines an accepted, operable change as the unit of engineering work. The approval-routing case separates business intention, implementation, verification and acceptance, showing why brownfield understanding and explicit decision rights still matter when an AI agent generates the patch.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: L'AI cambia l'unità di lavoro della software engineering

title: Measuring Productivity from Code to Production
summary: Examines productivity measures from generated output to accepted releases. It distinguishes randomized evidence from observational comparisons and develops a pilot that records review, rework, quality and hidden human effort before an adoption decision.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Misurare la produttività: dal codice alla produzione

title: Limits and Capability of Coding Agents
summary: Turns agent capability into a bounded engineering hypothesis. Permissions, tools, budgets, stopping rules and escalation constrain execution; the chapter compares execution routes and parallel work while keeping technical completion separate from authorized acceptance.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Limiti e capacità dei coding agent

title: Intentions, Contracts and Iterative Change
summary: Develops a versioned intention contract for an existing service. Behavioral examples and acceptance rules are established independently of implementation, while late policy changes trigger targeted impact analysis and invalidate only the decisions and evidence they affect.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

title: Quality, Architecture and Maintainability
summary: Separates immediate correctness from architectural fit and maintenance obligations. Through duplication, post-merge evidence and a second change to the running service, it develops fitness checks and explicit stewardship instead of treating a passing test suite as complete quality assurance.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

title: Securing Generated Code and Agent Runtimes
summary: Threat-models two distinct surfaces: the generated application and the agent runtime. Dependency provenance, prompt injection, tool permissions and external services become enforceable boundaries, with security evidence tied to the release decision.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Mettere in sicurezza il codice generato e i runtime degli agent

title: Independent Verification and the Oracle Problem
summary: Builds independent verification around authorized behavior. Regression cases, properties, counterexamples and mutants expose circular testing; correlated checker errors and benchmark limits motivate an evidence dossier that supports review without granting the maker acceptance authority.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

title: Code Review and Trust Calibration
summary: Allocates review effort by consequence and uncertainty. It examines human and AI reviewers, false positives, shared blind spots and automation bias, then separates finding disposition, coverage of acceptance obligations and the accountable release verdict.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Code review e calibrazione della fiducia

title: System Understanding, Context and Persistent Memory
summary: Treats context and persistent memory as claims with provenance, ownership and expiry. It develops software-specific knowledge records and invalidation rules, then uses a handoff and an explicitly limited retrieval comparison to test what a successor can reconstruct.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Comprensione del sistema, context e memoria persistente

title: Developer Learning, Mentoring and Comprehension Debt
summary: Distinguishes assisted task completion from retained competence. Mentoring, explanations, repairs and deliberate practice lead to delayed retention and transfer checks; proposed competence measures remain instruments to validate rather than established scores.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Apprendimento, mentoring e debito di comprensione degli sviluppatori

title: Teams, Governance and the Engineering Organization
summary: Moves from individual output to team throughput and decision rights. Policy owners, makers, checkers and release authorities coordinate parallel work and late intention changes, with operational feedback and review capacity governing staged, reversible adoption.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Team, governance e organizzazione dell'ingegneria del software

title: Economics, Jobs, Risk and Evidence-Based Adoption
summary: Evaluates the economics of the whole engineering loop, including human effort, failed attempts, maintenance and risk. Employment evidence and alternative explanations remain separate from forecasts; adoption requires a counterfactual, uncertainty bounds and a reversal condition.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Economia, lavoro, rischio e adozione basata sulle evidenze

title: Choosing Practices and Recognizing Their Limits
summary: Selects and combines practices from the observed problem rather than a fixed workflow. It compares proportionate responses, exposes over-engineering and unsafe shortcuts, and connects earlier volumes while asking which mechanisms can be omitted without losing the change obligations.
limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
title_it: Scegliere le pratiche e riconoscerne i limiti
